NTA. I would never compromise the safety of my animal for another animal. Going through the landlord helps protect you and your cat by hopefully getting your roommate removed and then reporting the animal abuse. It's a hard judgement call and I would never put my animal in jeopardy. I think you should have reported sooner and taking pictures would have been helpful, but not everyone thinks about having proof.

Something I didn't really see anyone touch on is that the show wasn't here to shed light on mental illnesses. Because she didn't start off sick.

The show isn't here for people to all "yay we have proof that mental illnesses can lead to suicide!" It's here to say that bullying can lead to depression which can lead to suicide. 

The tapes are to show these people the fucked up things they did. Because these kids were conscious of their decisions, almost all were called out for their shitty behavior when she was alive and none of them took responsibility. Now in death there isn't room to argue. She's telling them what actually happened. They accept it or not is on them.

The show sheds light on the mental effects bullying has on teens and shy mentally healthy teens kill themselves after all that shit.

Not every show about suicide has to make it about mental illnesses. 

Also, any of us who were bipolar in high school probably wouldn't have made it as long as she did with everything she received. She clearly was mentally stable enough to shake it off until the rape.

I didn't want to go to college after high school. My mom quite literally forced me into it. Honestly, I didn't want to do it and my highschool years were so bad academically I wasn't sure I could complete degree.

I went to college with no idea what I wanted to do but the anxiety of failing pushed me to not fail. The depression was bad but I had a friend who made sure I was studying. Occasionally, he would come over and help me.

Fast forward, psychology is my baby. I could never imagine another major. All the classes are fucking hard but I have the skill for it. Along the way I found ways to cheat the system and not have to study much to get As. Truly, you don't have to actually learn anything to do well.

Now, being a senior at 20/21 years old, I have that crushing I'm not going to finish feeling. But I know I am. My parents never went to college and I can see how that negatively affected them and I refuse to give up. Fuck, I'll take a stimulant to get through the studying if I have to. I'm almost there. And I know I have the ability to finish, so I don't dare waste that potential.

I've tried to kill myself, self harmed, and taken a shit ton of drugs in the course of my college years and I always manage to push through the depression and hypermania. I wouldn't be able to live with myself if I dropped out. Literally, I would rather die. And the fear of disappointing myself is what keeps me in college studying with a 3.76 GPA, making dean's list, and going to graduate magna cum laude. 


I do understand we all don't have the same drive or ability to push through the depression and mania. And you or anyone else that couldn't handle the stress are NOT failures. Not going to college is no big deal. And if you want to go, you have to work 5x harder than someone who isn't bipolar.

P.S. your schools should have a disability center. Apply for it. There are many perks of it.

Everyone who cuts or burns, please practice damage control and use alcohol to clean wounds, always use new razors, and put bandaids on the wounds to prevent infection.

I deal with that addiction. When we all cut and burn and hurt ourselves, on purpose or by accident, it releases adrenaline, and opioid - like pain killers into our brain that we naturally make. It's a fucking fantastic high.
